text:
andrew: uploaded parse telemetry snapshot for the 13:24 window — host-side parse p50 jump +15%, p95 +40%. attaching link to snapshot (s3://redwood-telemetry/4876543210-snapshot.json)

ops-bot: Canary rollout note: kernel-selection v2.3 -> v2.4 started 13:10, batch-hint changes at 13:12.

hikaru: hmm looks correlated. KV cache miss-rate also up ~12% in same window. Could be kernel binning change causing slightly different sequence-length routing -> more cold KV lookups.

maya: I pulled the snapshot. Stack traces point to parse/stream framing hotpath (host_preparse.cc:line 214). Also seeing more small writes on the gRPC path (`writev` spikes).

lina: repro steps? can we get a small reproducer to validate kernel selection impact vs batching? :eyes:

andrew: quick repro: run 50 qps against canary pool with mixed short/long sequences; you can run this curl loop: `for i in {1..500}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short text"}' https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate; done` — watch host parse metrics.

hikaru: thanks. quick diff that might be related: `kernel_selector.cpp` changed bin thresholds from 0.7->0.6 (commit cf3b9). That could push more requests to the ‘small-seq’ kernel which doesn't merge KV prefetches as aggressively.

maya: idea: revert bin threshold to 0.7 and run A/B for 30m. If KV misses drop and parse p95 improves, that's our culprit. Also propose a micro-fix: make the KV prefetch window independent of kernel bin so small-seq still prefetches N next tokens. Patch sketch:```diff
- if (kernel_bin == SMALL) prefetch = false;
+ prefetch = prefetch || prefetch_for_small_sequences;
```

lina: +1 on A/B. Also curious about the gRPC small-write surge — may be our chunking change in proxy (proxy/stream_chunker.go) that started at same time. Could be more roundtrips for chunk headers -> parse overhead.

andrew: good catch. telemetry timeline: kernel-selector change 13:10, proxy chunking tweak 13:11, batch-hint tweak 13:12. All within same minute range.

ops-bot: Alert created: PERF-TRIAGE-4123. Assigned to hikaru + maya. SLA target: triage in 2h.

hikaru: plan: (1) roll back kernel bin change on canary, (2) rollback proxy chunking tweak on canary, (3) run A/B for 30m each change, (4) collect KV miss & parse p95. I'll own 1+3. @maya can you own 2 and metric collection?

maya: taking 2 + metrics. I'll also instrument an extra counter for `kv_prefetch_hits` so we can see prefetch efficacy live.

andrew: if both rollbacks improve things we should land a hotfix that decouples kernel binning from prefetch behavior and adds a batching-heuristic guard to avoid tiny write storms on grpc.

lina: putting a short doc in the incident channel with timeline + quick mitigations. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Update: canary rollback jobs queued (job ids 7641, 7642). Will post status.

hikaru: I'll start the canary rollback now, ping when metrics start to stabilize.

maya: note for follow-up: add a test that simulates mixed short/long stream sequences to catch this in CI (e2e perf smoke).

andrew: agreed. thanks all — catching regressions early here saved a quarter-hour of customer pain.
